title: Universal $L^2$-approximation using median digital-net algorithms
summary: We propose a median digital-net algorithm for $L^2$-approximation of non-periodic functions over $[0,1]^s$, inspired by the recently developed median lattice algorithms for the periodic setting. The algorithm requires no smoothness or weight parameters but only a sufficiently large candidate Walsh index set $K$.
